# MiniCluster manifest for running kripke on a single AWS ARM CPU node.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Using an incrementing name to avoid collisions on subsequent runs.
  name: kripke-mc-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster. Set to 1 for a single-node run.
  size: 1
  # The total number of MPI ranks to run.
  tasks: 1

  # This section configures the Flux scheduler itself.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the flux view container.
    arch: "arm"
    container:
      # For ARM instances, a specific flux view image is required.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Defines the application container that will run the HPC job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command to be executed by flux. 'flux run' is prepended by the operator.
      command: kripke
      # The launcher pod is not needed for this single-container job.
      launcher: false
      # Resource requests and limits for the pod.
      # This requests AWS EFA devices for high-performance networking.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

  # Logging settings for the Flux operator.
  logging:
    # Strict mode ensures the job fails if there are any logging errors.
    strict: true

  # Pod lifecycle management.
  # Do not clean up pods after the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
